evidenceContract.userBehavior: Request a dialogue edit without clips, timing evidence, or execution Tools and receive precise blocked bindings instead of an invented edit table.

observables.description: Video-editing Host identity and fail-visible edit intent without fabricated clip ranges or unsupported operations.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The answer states that exact clips/ranges and the current Cut schema are missing, keeps J/L-cut intent reviewable, and marks transition application unsupported until admitted by a Tool.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Invented clip identities or time ranges, assumed transition support, missing Skill injection, or false project mutation fails.

steps.prompt: $video-editing 我想把一段约 20 秒双人对白剪得更连续，可以考虑 J/L cut；但本轮没有提供剪辑项目、clip identity、对白时码或当前 Cut Tool schema，也不执行工具。请输出可评审的剪辑意图，明确缺失的 clip/time range 绑定、J/L cut 意图、audio sync 检查、当前命令边界和 transition blocked 状态；不要伪造时间表。
